item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
FilmCan 1.5.0 — Quick Copy, Catalog, PDF reports, roll numbering
Copy straight from the Finder (right-click › Services › FilmCan Copy), find any clip and the drives that hold it in the Catalog, get a PDF report per destination, and let FilmCan name rolls and recognise camera cards. The main window and Quick Copy now share one clearer, more readable design.

item.title: Version 1.4.2
item.description:
FilmCan 1.4.2 — P0 integrity and persistence fixes
Verification now actually verifies, manifests no longer duplicate entries or record block-aligned sizes, the space preflight sums per volume, and an unreadable settings file is quarantined instead of erased.
